# Saas UI Pattern Catalog

This catalog is the frontend paved path for generated customer apps. It records
what is compiled now, what is deliberately kept as copyable source, and what
must never cross into the template. A disposition is closed to `live default`,
`ready source`, `reference-only`, or `rejected`.

## Pinned authorities

- Saas UI Pro: `saas-js/saas-ui-pro` at
  `ac3a40c8dc05e403f9d501a87c092646891d3c40`.
- TanStack Start Starter Kit Pro: `saas-js/tanstack-start-starter-kit-pro` at
  `b76cb4514b9ab47f7db87901cb9b593b4adc3129`.
- Chakra public file-upload composition: `chakra-ui/chakra-ui` at
  `c8ef4fb3146ecb82521a878eb6545b4c9598abd6`.

In the tables, `Pro pin`, `starter pin`, and `pins above` resolve only to these
exact hashes; they are not floating branches or version ranges.

The adapter / replacement column is mandatory: purchased source supplies
composition and interaction patterns, while Maestro's WorkOS, Convex, Confect,
Effect, TanStack Router, consent, and provider boundaries stay authoritative.

Reference-only source is never installed by the CLI. Activate it only when the
listed journey is owned and the existing template authority does not cover it.

| Chat details          | reference-only | `saas-js/saas-ui-pro` | Pro pin    | `packages/blocks/communication/chat-details/chat-details.tsx`                                                            | None             | Activate for an owned messaging journey with real message contracts          | Do not install `chat-details` now                 |

## Registry procedure and fallback

Use the pinned command from `apps/web`:

```sh
pnpm dlx @saas-ui/cli@0.0.2 add <catalog-registry-root> --yes
```

The accepted Pro/public registry roots are `sidebar1`, `integration-card`,
`notification-settings`, `workspace-members-settings`, `metric-card-simple`,
`task-card-with-labels`, `file-cards`, `files-list-card`,
`latest-messages-card`, `sortable-task-list`, `add-contact-drawer`,
`invite-people-modal`, `select-users-modal`, `manage-tags-modal`, `roles-menu`,
`navbar-tabs`, and the public file-upload URL recorded above. Starter-only
compositions are adapted from the pinned starter commit, not requested from a
registry. Reference-only and rejected roots are never installed.

If login, entitlement, or a transitive registry URL fails, record the public
error and adapt the smallest coherent composition from the pinned purchased
source with the source repo, commit, and path retained in its comment. Do not
hand-roll a replacement and do not stall the product lane waiting for registry
access. Strip backend/demo imports, use semantic tokens and installed
primitives, and add a dependency only when the checked-in adapted source imports
it.
